summary: Let accepted member peer backups reconcile uncertain publication autonomously. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: The operator starts the same backup; Core now reconciles accepted member publication after an outage. Remote kinds remain gated.

api.reason: The existing authenticated member backup operation may advance from needs_attention to an exact terminal result without Controller; no route or schema changes.

roadmap.reason: Repairs the current Core-owned backup recovery gate.

state.reason: No new durable record. Core already owns the member journal, run and adopted repository; the master reports the authenticated peer result to a fresh Controller.

verification.method: A focused member peer-publication predicate regression failed before the fix and passed afterward, refusing a journal that was not accepted from the master. Focused race passed. Independent read-only review found no concrete integration issue. A matched NFS two-Core fixture injected a post-sync lost reply plus exact-ID readback failure; with Controller off, normal-source Core restarts autonomously settled member/master succeeded, and fresh Controller adoption/exact replay held one point and old hashes. Forge CI remains open.
verification.limits: The native NFS cycle used a fixture-only injected readback error; actual server read failure and compatible S3 provider coverage remain open.
